item.title: Breaking: Docker Cloud Sandboxes — agent microVMs in the cloud (local↔cloud move)
item.description:
Docker launched Cloud Sandboxes today (Sep 24): the same microVM agent sandbox that already ran on your laptop, now on Docker-managed always-on compute, with one command to move either way (sbx move my-project --to cloud).

  • Each agent gets its own microVM (kernel + Docker daemon), secrets proxy (agents never see raw keys), network policies, and MCP gateway.
  • Kits ready today for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Antigravity, Open Code, and Hermes.
  • Pay-as-you-go by the second (Small default ~$0.14/hr); paused sandboxes free; sessions up to 24h.

Primary: docker.com/blog. Fits the “agent gets its own VM” watch.

  • Changelog: Still tops at Rollouts + Security Review (Sep 23) — already covered in yesterday’s breaking ping. No newer Cursor changelog entry overnight.

Product releases

Rolling out in Gemini API, AI Studio, Gemini Enterprise, Notebook, and Google Vids. (Google blog)

  • Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol/Luna remain the Sep 22 model drops already in Wednesday’s briefing — no net-new ChatGPT/Claude product ships overnight beyond the research note below.

Major AI news

item.title: Breaking: Cursor ships Rollouts + Security Review bots (Teams/Enterprise)
item.description:
Cursor (~today PT): Official changelog launch of two shipping bots. Rollouts watches each PR as it deploys and reports change health per environment (verified / regression / inconclusive); built with the Bot Development Kit (Cursor’s take on Firetiger Change Monitors). On regression it can notify, open a revert PR, or hand off to a cloud agent — it does not auto-merge or roll back. Security Review posts one PR comment on exploitable bugs (injection, authz bypass, secrets, SSRF, unsafe deserialization, vuln deps); style/quality stays with Bugbot. Both on Teams and Enterprise; enable from Automations. ~10 days of Rollouts trial credits (~50 Teams / ~500 Enterprise changes).

Primary: cursor.com/changelog (Sep 23). Status: All Systems Operational after a brief Grok 4.7 degradation ~1:28–1:36pm PT (resolved).

item.title: AI briefing — Weekday, Wed Sep 23, 2026
item.description:
Lead: Busy afternoon yesterday after a quiet Tuesday morning briefing. Tesla shipped Grok Bot in vehicles, Anthropic dropped Claude Opus 5.5, and OpenAI followed with GPT-6 Sol and Luna. Cursor status is green this morning.

Grok Bot / Cursor

  • Tesla + Grok Bot (Sep 22 ~1:06pm PT): Official in-car Grok Bot. With Connectors, drivers can manage inbox, calendar, and files/chats/tasks hands-free. Multi-step errands (coffee, reservations, shopping) are SuperGrok Heavy–only for now ($300/mo); Connectors setup is broader. AMD infotainment + software 2025.26+ typically required. Verge also notes Bloomberg’s ~400k weekly Grok Bot users ~a month after launch. (Verge · Not a Tesla App)
  • SpaceXAI support case study (Sep 22): Combined SpaceXAI/Cursor support rebuilt around Grok Bot — ~175% more tickets without new headcount; resolutions as low as ~$0.20–$0.30 vs $1–$4 typical. Plain + Linear + Datadog; refunds ~99% without human intervention. (x.ai/news)
  • Status: All Systems Operational this morning (Sep 23). No incidents today. Yesterday’s Grok 4.7 selection failure (~6:02–6:45am PT) and overnight Grok-models blip remain resolved. Changelog still tops at Projects (Sep 10).

Product releases

  • Claude Opus 5.5 (Sep 22 ~9:30am PT): First Claude 5.5 model. Anthropic: leads agentic coding / computer use / knowledge work; ~Fable 5.1-level on most work at ~40% less cost than Opus 5; clearer writing; strongest behavioral-audit scores to date. API claude-opus-5-5 — $4/$20 per M tokens (cache reads $0.20). Live on Claude Platform, AWS, GCP, Azure. Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 “coming weeks.” Biology/cyber safeguards in Fable 5.1 class. (Anthropic)
  • GPT-6 Sol + Luna (Sep 22 ~11am PT): Astra’s efficiency siblings — Sol for complex coding/agentic work, Luna for high-volume clerical tasks. 50% lower API prices vs GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna; OpenAI claims ~half the factuality mistakes vs prior Sol. Rolling out in ChatGPT Work + Codex (Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise/Edu) and the API; Luna on desktop for Free/Go. Banked rate-limit reset for Plus/Pro/Business. (TechCrunch · OpenAI community)
  • No net-new Gemini feature overnight; Workspace Study notebooks and Gemini 3.8 Live remain mid-September ships.

Major AI news

  • Model race compressed into one afternoon: Opus 5.5 then Sol/Luna within ~90 minutes, plus Tesla’s in-car Grok Bot. Quiet overnight after that wave.

Hermes

  • Still v0.21.4 (v2026.9.21) — no newer tag overnight. Patch rollup of ~1,800 PRs since v0.21.3 for Docker / Hermes Cloud; curated notes deferred to v0.22.0. (release)

Grok Bot on X (@bot)

  • No newer official @bot posts found since Fri Sep 18 (public x.com fetch 403; browser scrape pending). Still the voice wave: voice notes (Sep 18), “can talk now” (Sep 17). Primary: @bot.

item.title: AI briefing — Weekday, Mon Sep 21, 2026
item.description:
Lead: SpaceXAI shipped Grok 4.7 today — most capable model yet for coding and knowledge work, trained to natively understand the Grok Bot harness, at the same $2 / $6 per M token price as Grok 4.6. Available now in Cursor, Grok Build, and the Grok API. Overnight (~11:39pm–12:00am PT), a short Grok 4.6 degradation hit Automations / Cloud Agents / CLI / IDE; resolved by midnight PT. All Systems Operational this morning.

Grok Bot / Cursor

  • Grok 4.7 (Sep 21): Larger base + longer RL on multi-hour tasks; better self-verification and long context; native Grok Bot harness understanding. CursorBench 4.0: 46.3% (xhigh) vs Grok 4.6’s 40.4%. Fast variant = 2× output speed at 2× price. (x.ai/news/grok-4-7)
  • Status: Brief Grok 4.6 blip overnight (investigating 6:39 UTC → resolved 7:00 UTC Sep 21). Grok Bot component stayed Operational. Now All Systems Operational.
  • Product: Cursor changelog still tops at Projects (Sep 10).

Product releases

  • Grok 4.7 is the day’s ship (above). No fresh overnight ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini feature drops beyond what’s already briefed — Anthropic newsroom still measurements (Sep 17) / Fable 5.1; OpenAI Zendesk/OneNote plugins already in the Sep 3 release notes wave.

Major AI news

  • Antitrust catch-up (filed Fri Sep 18; CBS Sat Sep 19): Proposed N.D. Cal. class action alleges Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google illegally agreed to slow AI development after Amodei’s Sep 12 “pacing the frontier” essay. Named plaintiffs are paid ChatGPT / Claude / Grok / Gemini subscribers. Labs had not commented as of Saturday. (CBS)

Hermes

  • Still v0.21.3 (v2026.9.14) — no newer release tag overnight. (releases)

Grok Bot on X (@bot)

  • No newer public posts found since the Fri Sep 18 voice / voice-notes wave (same as Sun’s briefing). Themes still: voice calls on desktop/mobile + asynchronous voice notes. Concrete mirror: voice-notes status. Logged-out x.com/bot timeline unreadable this morning (403 / login wall).

Grok Bot / Cursor

item.title: Meta launches Muse — personal AI agent with its own Secure VM
item.description: Meta launched Muse (US): a personal AI agent that does work across email, calendar, payments, shopping, health, and more — not just chat. Each Muse runs on Muse Secure VM, a dedicated cloud computer with its own browser; a separate Sentinel agent gates network/sensitive actions. Primary: https://about.fb.com/news/2026/09/introducing-muse-personal-ai-agent/ · Product: https://muse.ai · Coverage: https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/08/meta-debuts-its-muse-ai-agent-will-consumers-trust-it/ · https://www.reuters.com/business/meta-launches-ai-agent-that-can-access-other-apps-send-emails-make-payments-2026-09-08/
item.content:encoded:
Meta launched Muse (US rollout): a personal AI agent that takes on tasks across email, calendar, payments, shopping, health, and more — not just answers questions.

Each Muse runs on Muse Secure VM, a dedicated cloud computer with its own browser; a separate Sentinel agent gates outbound network and sensitive actions (send email, purchase). Credentials stay in secure storage Muse cannot see.

Available at muse.ai, iOS, Android, and WhatsApp; free for most use, with Power ($20/mo) and Maximum ($100/mo) plans. Powered by Muse Spark. Glasses coming soon.

Primary: Meta Newsroom · Coverage: TechCrunch · Reuters

item.title: OpenAI claims Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize solution via multi-agent system
item.description: OpenAI published a claimed solution to the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness Millennium Prize problem (finite-time singularity; Clay statements C and D). An internal multi-agent system (~10,000 concurrent agents on a model OpenAI says is significantly more capable than GPT-6 Astra) produced an analytical proof; Lean formalization ran via GPT-6 Astra. Agents found the resolution ~88 hours after launch (Sat Sep 5); Lean verification +17 hours. Paper + Lean: https://cdn.openai.com/pdf/32d9f210-8b73-45e0-91bc-82a30aef8a9a/navier-stokes.pdf · https://github.com/openai/NavierStokesAndEuler. OpenAI says it will not claim the Millennium Prize; recognizes concurrent Euler priority of Tristan Buckmaster (NYU) and Levent Alpöge (Anthropic). Primary: https://openai.com/index/navier-stokes-solution/
